verdict.rationale: Obsidian exposes some programmatic surfaces — the Obsidian URI protocol for triggering actions like opening/creating notes, and a plugin API (Vault interface) for reading/writing files — but these fall short of full UI parity. There is no official CLI or vendor-provided REST/MCP API; the probe explicitly confirms no official CLI or MCP server exists, with third-party community plugins filling that gap instead. missing for 10: comprehensive first-party API/CLI covering all UI actions, official REST or MCP server, evidence of parity for non-file operations (e.g., graph view, canvas, settings) via API.
